# truefoundry_gateway_data_access_config (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway data access configuration: which subjects can see the gateway's observability data (traces and metrics). Applied as a `gateway-data-access-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The data access config is a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces all rules. Import the existing config with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_data_access_config.example gateway-data-access-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway data access config (singleton — define at most one).
resource "truefoundry_gateway_data_access_config" "access" {
  name = "data-access"

  rules = [
    # Everyone sees their own requests.
    {
      id         = "everyone-own-data"
      scope      = "own_data"
      subjects   = ["team:everyone"]
      data_types = ["traces", "metrics"]
    },

    # Team members see their team's requests.
    {
      id         = "everyone-team-data"
      scope      = "team_data"
      subjects   = ["team:everyone"]
      data_types = ["traces", "metrics"]
    },

    # Tenant admins see everything.
    {
      id         = "tenant-admin-all-data"
      scope      = "all_data"
      subjects   = ["role:tenant-admin"]
      data_types = ["traces", "metrics"]
    },

    # The platform team sees all traces of one gateway cluster.
    {
      id         = "platform-cluster-traces"
      scope      = "all_data"
      subjects   = ["team:platform"]
      data_types = ["traces"]

      filters = [
        {
          field  = "metadata"
          key    = "tfy_gateway_cluster"
          values = ["my-cluster"]
        },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the data access config.
- `rules` (Attributes Set) Data access rules; a subject sees data allowed by any matching rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway data access config.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `data_types` (Set of String) Kinds of observability data covered. Elements are one of: `traces`, `metrics`.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this rule, unique within the config.
- `scope` (String) Data the rule grants access to: `own_data` (the subject's own requests), `team_data` (requests of the subject's teams), or `all_data`. One of: `own_data`, `team_data`, `all_data`.
- `subjects` (Set of String) Subjects the rule applies to, as `<subject_type>:<name>` FQNs, e.g. team:everyone or role:tenant-admin.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `filters` (Attributes Set) Narrows an `all_data` rule to matching requests; not allowed on other scopes. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty set) for an unfiltered rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.filters`

Required:

- `field` (String) Request property to filter on. One of: `metadata`, `created_by`.
- `values` (Set of String) Values to match against (IN semantics).

Optional:

- `key` (String) Metadata key to match (required for `metadata` filters, not allowed otherwise).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The data access config is a tenant-wide singleton; its import ID is the
# fixed string "gateway-data-access-config".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_data_access_config.access gateway-data-access-config
```
